title: Strong Cosmic Censorship for Spherical Einstein–Vlasov Collapse
exact_target: For the prescribed spherical collapse data, prove formation of a central curvature singularity and strong cosmic censorship.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001362 (OWR-4129-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/46, pp. 2585--2646; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 22.
Andreasson--Kunze--Rein, gravitational collapse; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The claim concerns the particular shell-like initial-data class in the report's cited collapse theorem, not arbitrary data merely satisfying a>0 somewhere. The report proves future completeness of the event-horizon generator but only conjectures the central singularity and strong censorship. A regularity class for inextendibility remains necessary.
